paragraphs.text: Casimiro Ledezma Prieto participated in Operation Tamiz Fino on 2011-01-27. Liga del Cedro Lunar was linked to Operation Tamiz Fino on 2011-01-27. Operation Tamiz Fino occurred at Uruapan on 2011-01-27. A detained courier in contact with the reporting office described a raid by federal forces on properties in Uruapan that targeted assets of Liga del Cedro Lunar tied to Ledezma, the network's sicario chief. The courier stated that the raid was announced to the press under the name of the operation and that it recovered vehicles and weapons from a ranch on the road toward the hill country but did not result in the arrest of Ledezma, who had left the ranch the previous evening.

Operation Tamiz Fino transited Tierra Caliente plaza on 2011-01-27. Everardo Montemayor Ruvalcaba led Liga del Cedro Lunar from 2010-11-18 until 2018-04-26. The courier stated that the ranch sits on the road into the Tierra Caliente that the network uses to supply its laboratories and that the raid interrupted laboratory supply for about a week. The courier characterized Montemayor as the head of the network and stated that he ordered the laboratories to pause production until the federal units withdrew.

The reporting office assesses the courier as having direct access to the network's response to the raid and secondhand access to the raid itself. The courier added that the network believed the raid had been prompted by a dispute between Ledezma and a local police commander over a vehicle, and that Ledezma was reprimanded for drawing attention to the ranch. This information has not been corroborated by a second independent source at the time of writing. The reporting office continues to collect on the entities named in this report.
